query: query NbaStepInfo($slug: String!) { user(slug: $slug) { setBoard(sport: NBA, mode: CAREER) { steps { ... on CareerStep { id state lockedLineupsCount pendingLineupsCount remainingLineupsCount myTask { id ... on ThresholdPickerTask { pickOrList startDate expiresAt aasmState progress pickableDays(first: 10, timeZone: "Europe/Berlin") { nodes { date } } taskLineups { id score aasmState draft hasLiveGames } } } } } } } }
